title: 67dle - The 67 Number Game
tagline: Use four numbers and maths to make 67
description: A daily math puzzle. Combine four numbers with +, −, ×, ÷, ^ and ! to hit exactly 67.

title: Yeardle - Guess the year
tagline: Guess the year a historical event happened
description: A daily history puzzle — read the clue on the flashcard and guess the year in 5 tries.

title: Daily Hangman
description: A daily hangman puzzle — The classic hangman game where you guess letters one at a time until you get the word. Don't let that man hang!

title: Shikaku
tagline: Every number is a rectangle's area
description: A daily rectangle-division logic puzzle — draw rectangles so each one contains exactly one number, matching its area, until the whole grid is covered.

title: Sudoku-dle
tagline: Fill every row, column and box with 1-9
description: A daily Sudoku puzzle — fill the 9×9 grid so every row, column and box holds the digits 1–9, exactly once each.

title: Mini Sudoku-dle
tagline: A quicker 6x6 Sudoku, solved in minutes
description: A quick daily Mini Sudoku — fill the 6×6 grid so every row, column and 2×3 box holds the digits 1–6, exactly once each.

title: Define-dle
tagline: Guess the word from its definition
description: A daily word puzzle — read the dictionary definition and guess the word. Unlimited guesses, with Wordle-style letter feedback after each try.

title: Crossword-dle Mini
tagline: A tiny crossword, just three words
description: A tiny daily crossword — just three overlapping words and three clues. Quick enough for a coffee break, with a new grid every day.

title: Crossword-dle
description: A full daily crossword — a 9×9 grid with around 30 words, clued across and down. A bigger daily challenge than Crossword-dle Mini.

title: Cryptic-dle
tagline: One cryptic crossword clue, one word to guess
description: A daily cryptic crossword clue — crack the anagram, hidden word, reversal, charade, double definition or homophone, then guess the word. Unlimited guesses, but no letter-by-letter hints — the clue is the only way in.

title: Sequence-dle
tagline: Spot the pattern, fill the gaps
description: A daily number sequence puzzle — a couple of numbers are missing from the sequence. Work out the pattern and fill them in. Unlimited guesses.

title: Flow-dle
tagline: Connect the dots, don't cross the lines
description: A daily pipe-connecting logic puzzle — link every pair of matching coloured dots on an 8×8 grid without crossing a line, filling every cell to solve it.

title: Match-dle
description: A daily memory-matching puzzle — flip two tiles at a time and clear the board by finding all eight matching shape pairs on a 4×4 grid.

title: Node-dle
tagline: Trace every line. Never lift twice.
description: A daily one-line tracing puzzle. Every board is a fixed network of nodes with grey connections already drawn between them — drag across each one to trace it, without ever retracing the same line twice. It's always possible to trace the whole board in a single unbroken stroke; the fewer times you lift and restart, the better your score.

title: Stop the Clock
tagline: Feel the seconds. Stop on the dot.
description: A daily timing game. Today's number is a random whole number of seconds from 1 to 30 — hit Start, then hit Stop the instant you think that many seconds have passed. There's no visible clock while it's running, just your own sense of time. Try as many times as you like; your closest attempt is your best for the day.

title: Blackjack-dle
tagline: One hand a day, dealer included
description: A daily blackjack puzzle — one hand against the dealer, dealt from the same shuffle as everyone else. Hit, stand or double down, then come back tomorrow for a new shoe.

title: Connectly
tagline: One path, every cell, in order
description: A daily grid-tracing puzzle — connect the numbered dots in order with a single path that fills every cell on the 6×6 grid, without crossing or lifting.
